title: Brook Road Builders — Dogs, Trucks, Animals & a Little Scientist (Ages 3–4)
summary: Original single-narrator bedtime adventures for ages 3–4, especially a three-year-old who loves dogs, bears, trucks and construction machinery. Rex the puppy, Gus the bear cub and Jack the little boy scientist watch neighborhood work and make discoveries. Season One creates Pine Park; Season Two builds the pedestrian Little Bridge to Green Gate Farm and introduces Molly the puppy; Season Three follows the red tractor through a hay harvest, from mowing and drying to baling, wagon transport, and a first return visit to the park. Machines have distinct real-world functions, and completed places and objects remain in the story world. Narration is playful and settles gently; optional caregiver notes and fact sources are separate.
assumed_background: Primary listener is three years old; age range three to four. Enjoyment of trucks, dogs, bears, animals, construction machinery, and playful 'why' questions. Earlier episodes add recognition but are not essential.

lectures.title: Rex and the Yellow Digger
lectures.description: Rex, Gus and Jack visit the fenced Pine Park construction site and watch an excavator scoop and swing.

lectures.title: Gus and the Gravel Mountain
lectures.description: Gus watches dump trucks tip their beds to leave two gravel piles for the park path.

lectures.title: The Bulldozer and the Pancake Hill
lectures.description: A bulldozer pushes soil into a low mound, which Gus names Pancake Hill.

lectures.title: Rex and the Three Kinds of Tracks
lectures.description: A wheel loader moves gravel; Rex, Gus, and Jack compare tire patterns with paw marks at home.

lectures.title: The Road Roller and the Cookie Question
lectures.description: The crew compacts the gravel path with a roller, while Rex imagines a road-sized cookie.

lectures.title: The First Walk Through Pine Park
lectures.description: Pine Park opens, and the friends walk the completed path and read back Jack's notebook.

lectures.title: A Bark from the Other Side
lectures.description: Rex hears another puppy across the brook. A small excavator begins a walking bridge to Green Gate Farm, and Molly becomes a new neighbor.

lectures.title: The Truck with the Turning Drum
lectures.description: A concrete mixer truck brings material for the bridge supports while Gus wonders whether it is a washing machine for caps.

lectures.title: Jack's Bridge for an Acorn
lectures.description: During the bridge-building wait, Jack, Rex, and Gus compare flat and folded paper over two blocks with an acorn.

lectures.title: The Crane and the Long Wooden Bridge
lectures.description: A flatbed delivers a wooden footbridge deck and a crane truck lifts it onto checked supports while the friends watch.

lectures.title: Molly and the Little Loader
lectures.description: From the farm side Molly watches a compact loader bring gravel while the crew finishes the rails and both approaches.

lectures.title: The Bridge of Two Wagging Tails
lectures.description: The Little Bridge opens. Rex finally meets Molly at Green Gate Farm, and Jack draws the new connection.

lectures.title: The Tractor with Two Big Back Wheels
lectures.description: Molly welcomes Rex, Gus and Jack to the farm hayfield, where Farmer Ruth pulls a waiting wagon with her red tractor.

lectures.title: Gus and the Grass Haircut
lectures.description: A tractor-mounted mower cuts the hayfield grass, and Gus worries that the field has had a lopsided haircut.

lectures.title: Rex and the Hay That Floated
lectures.description: After a drying day, a hay tedder fluffs the cut grass while Rex and Molly try to decide whether the field is waving at them.

lectures.title: Jack and the Long Lines in the Field
lectures.description: Jack notices the rake collecting almost-dry hay into long windrows while Molly makes a maze of imaginary paths.

lectures.title: The Baler and the Little Hay Bricks
lectures.description: A baler gathers dry windrows into small rectangular hay bales while Gus imagines building a house for a giant sheep.

lectures.title: The Hay Wagon Comes Home
lectures.description: Adults load the little square bales onto the hay wagon, Farmer Ruth drives around by the farm lane, and Molly finally visits Rex at Pine Park.
